WARRIORPATH VISUAL QC FIXES APPLIED — src/app/page.tsx

ISSUES IDENTIFIED:
• [HIGH] 'WARRIOR PATH' text near-invisible (1.09:1 contrast)
• [MEDIUM] 4 elements fail WCAG AA (2.1:1 - 2.87:1 contrast)

FIXES APPLIED TO LANDING PAGE:
1. 'WARRIOR PATH' heading: Changed from text-[#f5f6f1] to text-white, enhanced text-shadow from [0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] to [0_2px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)]

2. 'AI' subheading: Changed from text-[#ff6b35] to text-[#ff4500] (darker orange), added [text-shadow:0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)], changed font-medium to font-bold

3. 'SOF CANDIDATE ACCELERATOR': Changed from text-[#a8b89c] to text-[#c8d4bc] (lighter sage for better contrast), enhanced text-shadow to [0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)], changed font-semibold to font-bold

4. Toggle buttons ('Access Code', 'Email / Password'): Changed active state from bg-[#ff6b35] to bg-[#d94e1f] (darker orange), added font-bold, improved inactive state text color

5. CardDescription: Changed from text-[#a8b89c] to text-[#d4e0c8] (lighter sage)

6. Helper text: Changed from text-[#a8b89c] to text-[#d4e0c8]

7. 'Enter WarriorPath' button: Added explicit bg-[#c44d20] hover:bg-[#a33d18] text-white font-bold classes for WCAG AA compliance

8. 'Sign in' button: Added explicit bg-[#c44d20] hover:bg-[#a33d18] text-white font-bold classes

EXPECTED RESULT AFTER DEPLOY:
- All contrast ratios should meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum
- Visual QC should return PASS

NEXT STEPS:
1. Deploy changes to warriorpath.ai
2. Re-run visual QC to verify PASS status

FILE MODIFIED: warriorpath/src/app/page.tsx
